title: Deterministic seed embedding text
purpose: Create one stable text payload per candidate primitive so actual embedding workers can run later without recomputing source normalization.
privacy_rule: Embedding text is synthetic seed metadata only and must not include private prompts or source material.

name: embedding_bucket
title: Use-case seed embedding bucket dimension
purpose: Attach a cheap deterministic bucket based on domain, risk tier, required-stage signature, and output signature.
privacy_rule: Bucket values must be derived from generic metadata, not raw private content.

title: Vector index embedding stub
purpose: Connect vector index records to object_embedding stubs so a later embedding worker can populate pgvector rows without changing index IDs.
privacy_rule: Vector index metadata uses object IDs, buckets, and canonical entity IDs only.

title: Embedding bucket comparison pruning
purpose: Use bucket equality as one early blocking key before lexical similarity, entity overlap, or dense vector search.
privacy_rule: Comparison workers should operate on normalized objects and generated metadata, not private raw source snapshots.
